d: Adam Hamilton has scripted a historic political upset in Kansas, defeating Trump-backed Republican Roger Marshall to become the state's first Democratic US Senator in 94 years. His victory marks a major breakthrough for Democrats in a deeply Republican state and strengthens their newly secured Senate majority. In his victory speech, Hamilton said voters across party lines were rejecting what was happening in Washington under Donald Trump.
